rules.statement: MMP 1.0.0 entrypoints, schemas, archive inventory, identifiers and manifest contract remain unchanged
1.0.0 consumer acceptance cannot be silently narrowed by candidate strict semantics
Strict Core candidate cardinality and required policies are selected explicitly, not implied by package_format_version 1.0.0
Datatype canonicalization, relation inheritance and extension negotiation are proposals with subset tests
Do not publish package_format_version 1.1.0 or claim full mmp-core support until normative and package conformance criteria pass
Changes to existing field meaning, new required declarations or critical extension flags require explicit version compatibility review

release_target: MMP Specification Kit 1.0.0 with candidate profiles labeled non-normative
